name: Booray
summary: A Cajun trick-taking gambling game where players ante, may drop, draw cards, and must win at least one trick to avoid penalty.
rules_text: Each hand players ante to a pot. Dealer deals five cards face down to each player one at a time and turns the next card to set trump. In turn left of dealer each player looks at their hand and either folds forfeiting the ante or stays in. Active players in order may discard 1-4 cards for replacements from the deck or stand pat. Then tricks are played: leader is left of dealer. If a player holds Ace, King or Queen of trump they must lead one of those when leading. Follow suit if possible, and if possible must beat any card already in the trick. If cannot follow, must trump if possible. Otherwise play any card. Highest card of led suit wins unless trumped, then highest trump wins. Winner leads next with same forced high trump rule. Most tricks wins the pot. A player who stayed but won zero tricks boorays and must match the pot for the next deal.
rating_reason: Trick-taking with ante, bluffing, hidden hands.
